7.body: Sentinel is proud to re-introduce its series of headcovers built using Kvadrat textiles. Each piece is cut and sewn in New York using the 3D knit fabric - A substantial, durable, and uniquely textured knit fabric made with a poly/wool/nylon blend. Details - Knit in Denmark - Cut & Sewn in New York - Melton Wool Lining (Made in USA) - Bar-tacked Nylon Strap Webbing

8.body: Sentinel is proud to introduce a series of head covers made by Japan-based FPS built using Kvadrat textiles. FPS is a Tokyo based label founded by husband and wife Tomio and Yukiko. Both have unique yet complimentary professions: one runs a commercial facility design office, while the other works in the production of fashion and accessories.  About two years ago, they started making head covers as a hobby. Without any brand image or strategy, they simply enjoy handcrafting pieces they love. Moving forward, Tomio and Yukiko plan to continue at our own pace, focusing primarily on custom orders. We have been big fans of their work from a distance and love the fact we got to work with them for this project. 9.body: The MajoTech Field Suit is by far our most technical project to date. Constructed with a 4-way stretch ripstop that is water repellent, windproof, and breathable to function in moderate to severe conditions. A super clean built-in zip and snap hood that is easily removed and re-attached. Waterproof waist and ankle zipper vents, adjustable wrist and ankle snaps, and finished off with quick release magnetic belt closure. Cut and sewn in New York, U.S.A. Components List: YKK RSuperlight PES Ripstop (Made in Italy by MajoTech) YKK 2-Way AquaGuard Zipper (Made in Canada) Riri Waterproof Reverse Coil Zipper (Made in Switzerland) Cordura Nylon Webbing (Made in U.S.A.) Kane-M Snaps (Made in Japan) Woojin Magic Buckle (Made in Korea) ⅛” Nylon Shock Cord (Made in U.S.A.) SIZE NOTE: Runs true to size. If in between sizes, size up. Greg is 6’1’’ and wearing L. Jacket Measurements (Aprx.) S: Chest 2

13.body: One-of-a-kind GGNC headcovers up-cycled from a one-of-a-kind vintage American floral nine-patch quilt, believed to date from circa 1970–1990 . Built from repeating squares of dusty pink polka-dot cotton, dark floral calico and warm cream, each headcover preserves the original quilt’s piecing, tonal variation and natural patina. One-of-a-kind items Vintage American floral nine-patch quilt Believed to date from circa 1970–1990 Traditional hand-pieced patchwork construction Rose-print floral calico and polka-dot cotton Original cream cotton quilt blocks Decades of natural fading, wear and patina Comes in Driver & Fairway wood size Fits all drivers up to 460cc PLEASE NOTE: These garments feature well-loved heirloom textiles that have been hand-picked from across America.
